scripts.postinstall: npm run copy:chart && npm run copy:sortable && npm run copy:altcha && npm run copy:deep-chat && npm run copy:tailwind-browser && npm run copy:codemirror && npm run copy:tailwind-design
scripts.copy:altcha: { echo '/*'; cat node_modules/altcha/LICENSE.txt; echo '*/'; cat node_modules/altcha/dist/main/altcha.i18n.min.js; } > public/js/altcha-i18n.min.js
scripts.copy:tailwind-browser: { echo '// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Tailwind Labs, Inc. <https://tailwindcss.com>'; echo '// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT'; echo; cat node_modules/@tailwindcss/browser/dist/index.global.js; } > public/js/tailwindcss-browser.js
